entities.summary: Karl Theodor Reye was a German mathematician. He contributed to geometry, particularly projective geometry and synthetic geometry. He is best known for his introduction of configurations in the second edition of his book, Geometrie der Lage. The Reye configuration of 12 points, 12 planes, and 16 lines is named after him.
